messages:
Nina Park: Thanks for joining the security segment—threading follow-ups on KMS/BYOK, VPC evidence, audit log exports, and SOC2/ISO readiness.
Omar Haddad: Quick one: for Private deployments, do we support customer-managed KMS keys out-of-the-box or require a connector?
Nina Park: We support cloud KMS BYOK directly via our integration. For on-prem HSMs customers use our connector plugin; GA timeline Q3.
Rhea Kapoor: Are key rotation events automatically surfaced in audit bundles? Auditors always ask for rotation history.
Nina Park: Yes—rotation metadata (key id, timestamp, actor) is included in the signed evidence bundle if KMS integration is enabled.
Diego Morales: For fallback routing (Dedicated->Hosted) what happens to keys and logs? Any automatic export?
Nina Park: Fallback is policy-controlled. We don't auto-escrow customer keys; customers can enable cross-env escrow for seamless failover. Logs during failover are captured and signed, but customers must opt into centralized export.
Omar Haddad: OpsBot, link the draft runbook and the escrow RFC please.
OpsBot: <https://redwood.internal/docs/private-kms-runbook|private-kms-runbook> · <https://stash.redwood/rfcs/key-escrow|key-escrow-rfc>.
Rhea Kapoor: Action items?
Nina Park: (1) Publish Private evidence checklist (owner: Rhea) ETA 10 days; (2) Post KMS rotation examples + scripts (owner: Omar) ETA 4 days; (3) Draft fallback key-escrow tradeoffs (owner: Diego) ETA 7 days. We'll run a 30-min office hours next Tue for deeper questions.
Diego Morales: I'll loop in legal for the escrow doc.
Omar Haddad: I'll drop the rotation scripts in the docs repo today.
Nina Park: Thanks all—we'll update #announcements when items are live. :white_check_mark:
